services.name: Teens Classes
services.desc: We'll send you a 10% discount code for your first class, plus studio updates, new workshops and more. Unlock new creative possibilities in ceramics with our comprehensive Mold-Making 101 course. This hands-on class will guide you through the process of designing and creating plaster molds for both slip casting and press molding techniques. You’ll learn how to craft one-part and two-part molds, make decorative sprig molds, and combine slip-cast pieces into finished ceramic forms. This course is best for those with some hand-building experience. 1) Glazing is not part of this course. blurb: Join our women-owned Toronto pottery studio for hands-on classes, workshops, and private events. Learn wheel-throwing, handbuilding, sculptural ceramics, and creative pottery for beginners, kids, teens, and advanced students.

quotes.author: Rebecca
quotes.text: We just finished our class tonight and honestly I can't recommend Parkdale Pottery enough! Our teacher, Vanessa, was so patient with all of us 😅 and we had a ton of laughs. Such a great value for the price. It's a great experience whether you've done it before or not. Highly recommend checking them out, I can't wait to see my finished product!

quotes.author: Cheryl
quotes.text: The pottery wheel taster class was a great way to spend an evening with a friend! Nik did a fantastic job teaching us the basics and guiding us as we worked on our pieces. I'd definitely go again.

quotes.author: Erin
quotes.text: 10/10 experience! I came here for a friend’s birthday party and we had such a wonderful time. Both instructors were very informative and encouraging…which was very welcomed as it was the first time the majority of us had ever used a pottery wheel. Very reasonably priced as well.
